title: Hot Charred Venezuelan Shirataki Skewers
description: A charred, glassy-jelly, date-night Venezuelan dish featuring shirataki, deep-fry-tod, kosher-friendly
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together lime juice, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shirataki noodles to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated shirataki noodles onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Fry the shirataki skewers in the preheated oil for 2-3 minutes on each side, until charred and golden brown.
Remove the skewers from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the hot charred Venezuelan shirataki skewers immediately.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
